scope: Cross-device cache relocation never publishes interrupted copies
guarantees: Same-filesystem native rename retained; copying only after EXDEV.
Cross-device copy stages privately and atomically publishes only after complete copy.
Source stays intact until metadata commits.
Failed copy leaves source bytes, metadata and environment unchanged; staging cleaned and retry succeeds.
Preexisting empty target restored after failed copy.
Post-commit old source cleanup failure keeps valid committed target and warns.
limitations: EXDEV injected at native rename boundary; actual native temporary-file copying, no real mounted second drive or live user cache.
Metadata failure after completed cross-device publication preserves both complete copies with warning; caller must resolve the retained target before retry.
No UI/captions, model/network/GPU or full CI.
